The '''''Nashuaga''''' was a [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|''Dynamic''-class freighter]] that had crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[First Jedi Purge]]. It was located in the [[Wavelength Gale's hidden cove|hidden base]] of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] group [[Wavelength Gale]], and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was rumored to be the final resting place of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]]'s [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]].<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
